entries.reviewNotes: Read Tanabe museum tool-label context and all12 sets: carry on back with shoulder straps frees hands, related straps in right case, copy label seated clear of passage without using case as desk, record paired name and lower-right exhibit number.

Read pharmacy name-mismatch context and all12 sets: surname same given name differs, unopened bag handover stopped, prescription and reception records checked with kanji/reading, explanation sheet has same wrong name, wait without dosing pending matching.

Read payroll bank application context and all12 sets: branch may be requirement or example, ask employer first, current/residence-card address differs, bank cannot amend card, confirmed missing items listed and opening/time depend on later documents review.

Read sleepy post-night-shift rail context and all12 sets: intended third station not terminus, destination display checked, no promise to wake passenger or certainty from phone alert, rest in waiting room then decide and recheck route/stops if changing service.

Read parent-child course eligibility context and all12 sets: parent alone seeks school-letter practice while child at school, choose guardian consultation over conversation games, anonymized examples and actual named letter require prior staff check, verify audience/content before applying.

Read medical appointment timing context and all12 sets: ten gathering distinct from ten-thirty planned test start, companion mistakenly told later time, correct both times and check companion requirement, ask staff progress and unknown preparation term afterwards.

Read bank private-consultation context and all12 sets: acquaintance nearby, no details spoken or reason disclosed when called, number-only calling, keep passbook closed, seat near entrance sees number, discuss dates/questions only after relocation and ID check.

Read frozen-fish misplaced product context and all12 sets: blue bag on second snack shelf about five minutes uncertain, no self return/refreezing, distinguish white bag in basket, show location and leave saleability assessment to staff.

Read forgotten rally stamp-sheet context and all12 sets: third stop, original two stamps only photographed, no skin stamping or drawing prior stamps, spare gets current stamp only, record participant number and bring both sheets to staff for handling.

Read commemorative stamp context and all12 sets: preserve travel-ticket readability, use notebook blank page and protective interleaf for reverse work schedule, test orientation separately, ticket returned wallet and test paper taken home, stamp returned.

Read essay submission context and all12 sets: eight-hundred characters misread as lines, count manuscript squares not rows, title/name inclusion unresolved with coordinator, single event rather than repetition, check deadline/counting before rewrite.

Read blood-pressure preparation context and all12 sets: rolled thick seam tight on arm, remove jacket rather than pull, right hand grip difficulty with support only at jacket shoulder, own arm withdrawn slowly, no pain, jacket bagged and no measurement yet.

Read white powder observation context and all12 sets: unknown powder and nearby bag under parked car, no touching/collection or chemical identification, no accusation against unknown owner, no current state/photos, relative entrance/walkway position diagram offered.

Read personal shipping-label contact context and all12 sets: company number started but personal mobile replaces it on fresh legible form, daytime unavailability and no time field, contact/delivery handling checked without guaranteed call time, old form withheld.

Read shared-household finance context and all12 sets: rent-payment confirmation distinct from PIN/account access, no PIN on shared budget or spoken aloud, receipts contain private data, self-operated account with date/amount-only budget considered, identity checks may apply.

Read untasted-product survey context and all12 sets: no borrowing friend taste opinion, leave taste score blank per this form, own visual packaging observations only with readable large product name, no obligation to purchase merely to answer.

Read suspicious side-job contact correction context and all12 sets: correct earlier no-information claim to name/phone actually sent, address draft deleted unsent, today registration fee pressure but no payment history, two unread messages, three statuses kept distinct.

Read paper-model shipping context and all12 sets: child three-dimensional house roof must not be pressed to fit envelope, shoebox also too short, taller protective box with no movement needed, no final price/date before packing, grandma notified of delay.

Read all twelve locales against the Japanese bank exchange: distinguish differently typed identifiers, transaction acceptance status, and creditor allocation; retain the decision to postpone a second transfer.
Read all twelve locales against overlooked detergent at the basket bottom, separate carried bag, additional 380-yen purchase with 500 yen and 120 yen change, and retention of both receipts.

Read all twelve locales for participation versus ability to teach arm movements, refusal to invent replacement exercise, attendance-list assistance and referring movement questions to the arriving teacher.

Read all twelve locales for ten oclock being an information update rather than train departure, waiting near the display until platform instructions, and withholding arrival estimates from the person collecting the passenger.

Read all twelve locales for Rin versus Rimu, Thursday 14:00 reservation 52, shielding email ending eight, identity matching before reading-only correction and preserving blank kanji and Latin spelling.

Read all twelve locales for the addressed referral envelope versus personal appointment information, keeping the envelope sealed and dry without folding, separate storage of the appointment sheet, and hospital reception handover.

Read all twelve locales for correcting three keys to four using last weeks photo, two long plus round-handled plus small silver box key, unchanged blue cloth decoration and later comparison against the revised breakdown.

Read all twelve locales for Tuesday delivery beyond Sunday storage deadline, unavailable household, no date alteration, checking handling-office conditions before relying on a colleague, and notifying the older sister sender.
sourceIssues: Japanese turn 3 asks 今日までに受け取れる日はありますか (days up to today), while turn 4 answers about today, tomorrow and Sunday before the storage deadline. This appears to intend 期限まで rather than 今日まで; all translations preserve the source and no Japanese correction was made.
